}
```

  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { TableView(columns: ["Name", "Status"], rows: [["Ana Lima", "Active"], ["Ben Okafor", "Away"]]).variant("noVerticalHeader"); Text("noVerticalHeader").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
